description: Metric history is exposed through the timeline API and consumed by the dashboard's shared time-range and incident-timeline views. Dedicated long-horizon statistical trend analysis remains future work.

requirements.description: The system should expose metric history through a dedicated timeline endpoint and render it against the shared observation window used by the dashboard.
requirements.title: Historical Trend Analysis System

validation.notes: Validate trend analysis across multiple time periods
Analysis completion < 2s for 30 days of data
Trends accurately identify system behavior patterns

title: Historical metric timeline and trend context
